## Safety and rights
- [ ] No real credentials, business datasets, dump, internal documents or logs
- [ ] Contribution rights confirmed; third-party source/notice retained
- [ ] Default tests remain offline; DB integration requires explicit isolated fixture
- [ ] No regression in TRUNCATE, retry/unknown commit, COUNT or completion contracts
- [ ] Documentation and license inventory updated where affected
- [ ] No unrequested product version change, release or publication action
